description.html: With a volume of 182.3 liters and dimensions of 90x45x45 cm, this terrarium includes a handmade 3D background. The background imitates natural relief, such as rock or bark, and adds depth to the space so animals can climb, hide and feel more secure.

The horizontal layout with 90 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. Terrestrial reptiles actively choose their temperature by moving between zones, and this space lets them do that. The ventilation openings are placed to create natural airflow from bottom to top, which maintains optimal humidity.

Every terrarium we make is handmade, so you can choose the dimensions, film color, ventilation type and 3D background style. We also build fully custom models to your needs, so contact us for a consultation. Delivery throughout Serbia.
